name: Mark V "Sand Panther" hunting rifle
description: The Mark V "Sand Panther" hunting rifle was a type of slugthrower rifle manufactured by Coronet Arms, and was based on an ancient rifle once used to hunt Corellian sand panthers. This slugthrower was a design of beauty, as much artwork as functional weapon, it employed golden creshik wood imported from Tralus for its hand-carved furniture and stock. Aimed largely at collectors and enthusiasts, the Mark V rose in popularity for several decades as a retirement gift among Corellians.
